name: stench
effect: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.
descriptionEs: Puede amedrentar al rival al atacarlo debido al mal olor que emana.
descriptionEn: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

name: drizzle
effect: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Hace que llueva al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

name: speed-boost
effect: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Velocidad en cada turno.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.

name: battle-armor
effect: Protects against critical hits.
descriptionEs: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
descriptionEn: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

name: sturdy
effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.
descriptionEs: Evita que el rival pueda debilitarlo de un solo golpe cuando tiene los PS al máximo. También evita los movimientos fulminantes.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

name: damp
effect: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la humedad del entorno y evita que se puedan utilizar movimientos explosivos, tales como Autodestrucción.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

name: limber
effect: Prevents paralysis.
descriptionEs: Evita ser paralizado gracias a la flexibilidad de su cuerpo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

name: sand-veil
effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Evasión durante las tormentas de arena.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

name: static
effect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
descriptionEs: La electricidad estática que lo envuelve puede paralizar al mínimo contacto.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

name: volt-absorb
effect: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
descriptionEn: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

name: water-absorb
effect: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
descriptionEn: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

name: oblivious
effect: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.
descriptionEs: Su indiferencia evita que sea provocado o caiga presa del enamoramiento.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

name: cloud-nine
effect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
descriptionEs: Anula todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico.
descriptionEn: Eliminates the effects of weather.

name: compound-eyes
effect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la precisión de sus movimientos.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

name: insomnia
effect: Prevents sleep.
descriptionEs: Su resistencia al sueño le impide quedarse dormido.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.

name: color-change
effect: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.
descriptionEs: Adopta el tipo del último movimiento del que es blanco.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

name: immunity
effect: Prevents poison.
descriptionEs: Su sistema inmunitario evita el envenenamiento.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.

name: flash-fire
effect: Protects against Fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza algún movimiento de tipo Fuego, potencia sus propios movimientos de dicho tipo.
descriptionEn: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

name: shield-dust
effect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
descriptionEs: El polvo de escamas que lo envuelve lo protege de los efectos secundarios de los ataques recibidos.
descriptionEn: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

name: own-tempo
effect: Prevents confusion.
descriptionEs: Como le gusta hacer las cosas a su manera, los rivales no logran confundirlo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

name: suction-cups
effect: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.
descriptionEs: Sus ventosas se aferran al suelo, con lo cual anula movimientos y objetos que fuerzan el relevo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

name: intimidate
effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate amilana al rival de tal manera que su Ataque disminuye.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

name: shadow-tag
effect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.
descriptionEs: Impide que el enemigo huya o sea cambiado por otro.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

name: rough-skin
effect: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
descriptionEs: Hiere con su piel áspera al rival que lo ataque con un movimiento de contacto.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.

name: wonder-guard
effect: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.
descriptionEs: Gracias a un poder misterioso, solo le hacen daño los movimientos supereficaces.
descriptionEn: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.

name: levitate
effect: Evades Ground moves.
descriptionEs: Su capacidad de flotar sobre el suelo le proporciona inmunidad frente a los movimientos de tipo Tierra.
descriptionEn: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

name: effect-spore
effect: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.
descriptionEs: Puede dormir, envenenar o paralizar al Pokémon con el que entre en contacto al recibir un ataque.
descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.

name: synchronize
effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
descriptionEs: Contagia el envenenamiento, las quemaduras o la parálisis al Pokémon que le cause ese estado.
descriptionEn: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

name: clear-body
effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

name: natural-cure
effect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.
descriptionEs: Cura sus problemas de estado al cambiarse con otro Pokémon.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

name: lightning-rod
effect: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
descriptionEs: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

name: serene-grace
effect: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la probabilidad de que los movimientos causen efectos secundarios.
descriptionEn: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.

name: swift-swim
effect: Doubles Speed during rain.
descriptionEs: Sube su Velocidad cuando llueve.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

name: chlorophyll
effect: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.
descriptionEs: Sube su Velocidad cuando hace sol.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

name: illuminate
effect: Doubles the wild encounter rate.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la probabilidad de encontrar Pokémon al iluminar el entorno.
descriptionEn: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

name: trace
effect: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate copia la habilidad del rival.
descriptionEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

name: huge-power
effect: Doubles Attack in battle.
descriptionEs: Duplica la potencia de sus ataques físicos.
descriptionEn: Doubles the Pokémon's Attack stat.

name: poison-point
effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.
descriptionEs: Puede envenenar al mínimo contacto.
descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

name: inner-focus
effect: Prevents flinching.
descriptionEs: Gracias a su profunda concentración, no se amedrenta ante los ataques del rival.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

name: magma-armor
effect: Prevents freezing.
descriptionEs: Gracias al magma candente que lo envuelve, no puede ser congelado.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

name: water-veil
effect: Prevents burns.
descriptionEs: Evita las quemaduras gracias a la capa de agua que lo envuelve.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.

name: magnet-pull
effect: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.
descriptionEs: Su magnetismo atrae a los Pokémon de tipo Acero y les impide huir.
descriptionEn: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

name: soundproof
effect: Protects against sound-based moves.
descriptionEs: Su aislamiento acústico lo protege de movimientos que usan sonido.
descriptionEn: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

name: rain-dish
effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.
descriptionEs: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando llueve.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

name: sand-stream
effect: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Crea una tormenta de arena al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

name: pressure
effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
descriptionEs: Presiona al rival para que sus PP se acaben antes.
descriptionEn: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

name: thick-fat
effect: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
descriptionEs: Gracias a la gruesa capa de grasa que lo protege, reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques de tipo Fuego o Hielo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

name: early-bird
effect: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.
descriptionEs: Si se duerme, tardará la mitad de tiempo en despertarse.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

name: flame-body
effect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
descriptionEs: Puede quemar al mínimo contacto.
descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

name: run-away
effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
descriptionEs: Puede escaparse de todos los Pokémon salvajes.
descriptionEn: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

name: keen-eye
effect: Prevents accuracy from being lowered.
descriptionEs: Su aguda vista evita que le disminuya la Precisión.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

name: hyper-cutter
effect: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Evita que el rival le baje el Ataque.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

name: pickup
effect: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items.  May also pick up an item after battle.
descriptionEs: Puede recoger objetos que el rival haya usado, o bien otros que encuentre en plena aventura.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

name: truant
effect: Skips every second turn.
descriptionEs: Al ejecutar un movimiento, descansará en el turno siguiente.
descriptionEn: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.

name: hustle
effect: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque, pero reduce su Precisión.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.

name: cute-charm
effect: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.
descriptionEs: Puede causar enamoramiento al rival que lo toque.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.

name: plus
effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.
descriptionEs: Potencia su Ataque Especial si un Pokémon aliado tiene la habilidad Más o Menos.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

name: minus
effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.
descriptionEs: Potencia su Ataque Especial si un Pokémon aliado tiene la habilidad Más o Menos.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

name: forecast
effect: Changes Castform's type and form to match the weather.
descriptionEs: Cambia a tipo Agua, Fuego o Hielo en función del tiempo atmosférico.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

name: sticky-hold
effect: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Los objetos se quedan pegados a su cuerpo, por lo que no pueden robárselos.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

name: shed-skin
effect: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.
descriptionEs: Puede curar sus problemas de estado al mudar la piel.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

name: guts
effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
descriptionEs: Si sufre un problema de estado, se viene arriba y aumenta su Ataque.
descriptionEn: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

name: marvel-scale
effect: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
descriptionEs: Sube su Defensa si sufre un problema de estado.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.

name: liquid-ooze
effect: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.
descriptionEs: Exuda una sustancia tóxica de intenso hedor que hiere a quienes intentan drenarle PS.
descriptionEn: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.

name: overgrow
effect: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
descriptionEn: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

name: blaze
effect: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Fuego cuando le quedan pocos PS.
descriptionEn: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

name: torrent
effect: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
descriptionEn: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

name: swarm
effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Bicho cuando le quedan pocos PS.
descriptionEn: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

name: rock-head
effect: Protects against recoil damage.
descriptionEs: No puede dañarse con sus propios movimientos.
descriptionEn: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

name: drought
effect: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Cuando entra en combate, el tiempo pasa a ser soleado.
descriptionEn: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: arena-trap
effect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.  Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.
descriptionEs: Evita que el rival huya.
descriptionEn: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing from battle.

name: vital-spirit
effect: Prevents sleep.
descriptionEs: Su determinación le impide quedarse dormido.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

name: white-smoke
effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
descriptionEs: El humo blanco que lo protege evita que otros Pokémon le bajen las características.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

name: pure-power
effect: Doubles Attack in battle.
descriptionEs: Duplica la potencia de sus ataques físicos gracias al yoga.
descriptionEn: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

name: shell-armor
effect: Protects against critical hits.
descriptionEs: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
descriptionEn: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

name: air-lock
effect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
descriptionEs: Neutraliza todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico.
descriptionEn: Eliminates the effects of weather.

name: tangled-feet
effect: Doubles evasion when confused.
descriptionEs: Sube su Evasión si está confuso.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.

name: motor-drive
effect: Absorbs Electric moves, raising Speed one stage.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, le sube la Velocidad en vez de sufrir daño.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.

name: rivalry
effect: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.
descriptionEs: Si el objetivo es del mismo sexo, su competitividad le lleva a infligir más daño. Si es del sexo contrario, en cambio, el daño será menor.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

name: steadfast
effect: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.
descriptionEs: Cada vez que se amedrenta sube su Velocidad, debido a su voluntad inquebrantable.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.

name: snow-cloak
effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail.  Protects against hail damage.
descriptionEs: Sube la Evasión cuando graniza.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

name: gluttony
effect: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.
descriptionEs: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, engulle la baya que normalmente solo se comería cuando le quedasen pocos PS.
descriptionEn: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.

name: anger-point
effect: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.
descriptionEs: Si recibe un golpe crítico, monta en cólera y sube su Ataque hasta el máximo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

name: unburden
effect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
descriptionEs: Sube su Velocidad si usa o pierde el objeto que lleva.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

name: heatproof
effect: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.
descriptionEs: Su cuerpo, resistente al calor, reduce a la mitad el daño recibido por movimientos de tipo Fuego.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's heatproof body halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.

name: simple
effect: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers.  These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.
descriptionEs: Duplica los cambios en las características.
descriptionEn: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.

name: dry-skin
effect: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain.  Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
descriptionEs: Pierde PS si hace sol y los recupera si llueve o recibe un movimiento de tipo Agua. Los movimientos de tipo Fuego, por su parte, le hacen más daño de lo normal.
descriptionEn: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

name: download
effect: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Compara la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del rival para ver cuál es inferior y aumenta su propio Ataque o Ataque Especial según sea lo más eficaz.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon compares an opposing Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.

name: iron-fist
effect: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de los puñetazos.
descriptionEn: Powers up punching moves.

name: poison-heal
effect: Heals for 1/8 max HP after each turn when poisoned in place of damage.
descriptionEs: Si resulta envenenado, recupera PS en vez de perderlos.
descriptionEn: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

name: adaptability
effect: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.
descriptionEs: Potencia aún más los movimientos cuyo tipo coincida con el suyo.
descriptionEn: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

name: skill-link
effect: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.
descriptionEs: Ejecuta siempre los movimientos múltiples con el número máximo de golpes.
descriptionEn: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

name: hydration
effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
descriptionEs: Cura los problemas de estado si está lloviendo.
descriptionEn: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.

name: solar-power
effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.
descriptionEs: Si hace sol, aumenta su Ataque Especial, pero pierde PS en cada turno.
descriptionEn: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

name: quick-feet
effect: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la Velocidad si sufre problemas de estado.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

name: normalize
effect: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act Normal-type.
descriptionEs: Hace que todos sus movimientos se vuelvan de tipo Normal y aumenten ligeramente su potencia.
descriptionEn: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

name: sniper
effect: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.
descriptionEs: Potencia los golpes críticos que asesta aún más de lo normal.
descriptionEn: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

name: magic-guard
effect: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.
descriptionEs: Solo recibe daño de ataques.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

name: no-guard
effect: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.
descriptionEs: Al quedar ambos expuestos, tanto sus movimientos como los del rival acertarán siempre.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.

name: stall
effect: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.
descriptionEs: Ejecuta su movimiento tras todos los demás.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.

name: technician
effect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.
descriptionEs: Potencia sus movimientos más débiles.
descriptionEn: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

name: leaf-guard
effect: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.
descriptionEs: Evita los problemas de estado si hace sol.
descriptionEn: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

name: klutz
effect: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.
descriptionEs: No puede usar objetos equipados.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

name: mold-breaker
effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
descriptionEs: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

name: super-luck
effect: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
descriptionEs: Su buena suerte aumenta la probabilidad de asestar golpes críticos.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

name: aftermath
effect: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.
descriptionEs: Daña al agresor que le ha dado el golpe de gracia con un movimiento de contacto.
descriptionEn: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.

name: anticipation
effect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.
descriptionEs: Prevé los movimientos peligrosos del rival.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

name: forewarn
effect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Indica el movimiento más potente del rival al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

name: unaware
effect: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.
descriptionEs: Pasa por alto las mejoras en las características del rival al atacar.
descriptionEn: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.

name: tinted-lens
effect: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos que no son muy eficaces, que infligen ahora un daño normal.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.

name: filter
effect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
descriptionEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
descriptionEn: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

name: slow-start
effect: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Baja a la mitad su Ataque y su Velocidad durante cinco turnos.
descriptionEn: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.

name: scrappy
effect: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Puede alcanzar a Pokémon de tipo Fantasma con movimientos de tipo Normal o Lucha.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

name: storm-drain
effect: Redirects single-target Water moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
descriptionEs: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Agua, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

name: ice-body
effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail.  Protects against hail damage.
descriptionEs: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando hay tormentas de granizo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

name: solid-rock
effect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
descriptionEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
descriptionEn: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

name: snow-warning
effect: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Invoca una tormenta de granizo al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.

name: honey-gather
effect: The Pokémon may pick up Honey after battle.
descriptionEs: Puede que encuentre Miel una vez concluido el combate.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.

name: frisk
effect: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Puede ver el objeto que lleva el rival al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

name: reckless
effect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos que también dañan al usuario.
descriptionEn: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

name: multitype
effect: Changes Arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.
descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo al de la tabla o al del Cristal Z que lleve.
descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the plate it holds.

name: flower-gift
effect: Increases friendly Pokémon's Attack and Special Defense to 1.5× during strong sunlight.
descriptionEs: Si hace sol, aumenta su Ataque y su Defensa Especial, así como los de sus aliados.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies in harsh sunlight.

name: bad-dreams
effect: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.
descriptionEs: Inflige daño a cualquier rival que esté dormido.
descriptionEn: Damages opposing Pokémon that are asleep.

name: pickpocket
effect: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.
descriptionEs: Si el rival usa un movimiento de contacto al atacar, le roba el objeto.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.

name: sheer-force
effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.
descriptionEs: Sube la potencia de sus movimientos en detrimento de los efectos secundarios, que se ven anulados.
descriptionEn: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

name: contrary
effect: Inverts stat changes.
descriptionEs: Invierte los cambios en las características: bajan cuando les toca subir y suben cuando les toca bajar.
descriptionEn: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

name: unnerve
effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
descriptionEs: Pone nervioso al rival y le impide usar bayas.
descriptionEn: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

name: defiant
effect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.
descriptionEs: Sube mucho su Ataque cuando el rival le baja las características.
descriptionEn: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

name: defeatist
effect: Halves Attack and Special Attack at 50% max HP or less.
descriptionEs: Se debilita tanto cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad que su Ataque y su Ataque Especial bajan.
descriptionEn: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.

name: cursed-body
effect: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Puede anular el movimiento usado en su contra.
descriptionEn: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.

name: healer
effect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.
descriptionEs: A veces cura los problemas de estado de un aliado.
descriptionEn: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.

name: friend-guard
effect: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.
descriptionEs: Reduce el daño que sufren los aliados.
descriptionEn: Reduces damage dealt to allies.

name: weak-armor
effect: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.
descriptionEs: Al recibir daño de un ataque físico, le baja la Defensa, pero le sube mucho la Velocidad.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.

name: heavy-metal
effect: Doubles the Pokémon's weight.
descriptionEs: Duplica su peso.
descriptionEn: Doubles the Pokémon's weight.

name: light-metal
effect: Halves the Pokémon's weight.
descriptionEs: Reduce a la mitad su peso.
descriptionEn: Halves the Pokémon's weight.

name: multiscale
effect: Halves damage taken from full HP.
descriptionEs: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
descriptionEn: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

name: toxic-boost
effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× when poisoned.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de sus ataques físicos cuando está envenenado.
descriptionEn: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.

name: flare-boost
effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when burned.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de sus ataques especiales cuando sufre quemaduras.
descriptionEn: Powers up special moves when the Pokémon is burned.

name: harvest
effect: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.
descriptionEs: Puede reutilizar varias veces una misma baya.
descriptionEn: May create another Berry after one is used.

name: telepathy
effect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
descriptionEs: Elude los ataques de los aliados durante el combate.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

name: moody
effect: Raises a random stat two stages and lowers another one stage after each turn.
descriptionEs: Una característica le sube mucho en cada turno, pero le baja otra.
descriptionEn: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.

name: overcoat
effect: Protects against damage from weather.
descriptionEs: No le afectan las tormentas de arena, el granizo y los movimientos con polvos.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

name: poison-touch
effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.
descriptionEs: Puede envenenar al objetivo con solo tocarlo.
descriptionEn: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

name: regenerator
effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.
descriptionEs: Recupera unos pocos PS al ser cambiado por otro Pokémon.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.

name: big-pecks
effect: Protects against Defense drops.
descriptionEs: Impide que el rival le baje la Defensa.
descriptionEn: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.

name: sand-rush
effect: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Velocidad durante las tormentas de arena.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

name: wonder-skin
effect: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.
descriptionEs: Presenta una mayor resistencia ante los movimientos de estado.
descriptionEn: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.

name: analytic
effect: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de su movimiento si es el último en atacar.
descriptionEn: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

name: illusion
effect: Takes the appearance of the last conscious party Pokémon upon being sent out until hit by a damaging move.
descriptionEs: Adopta el aspecto del último Pokémon del equipo al entrar en combate para desconcertar al rival.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its Trainer's party.

name: imposter
effect: Transforms upon entering battle.
descriptionEs: Se transforma en el Pokémon que tiene enfrente.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.

name: infiltrator
effect: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.
descriptionEs: Ataca sorteando la barrera o el sustituto del rival.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.

name: mummy
effect: Changes attacking Pokémon's abilities to Mummy on contact.
descriptionEs: Contagia la habilidad Momia al rival que entre en contacto con él.
descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.

name: moxie
effect: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Al debilitar a un objetivo, su confianza se refuerza de tal manera que aumenta su Ataque.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

name: justified
effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, aumenta el Ataque debido a su integridad.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

name: rattled
effect: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, Bicho o Fantasma, el miedo hace que le suba la Velocidad.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

name: magic-bounce
effect: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.
descriptionEs: Puede devolver los movimientos de estado lanzados por el rival, sin verse afectado por ellos.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

name: sap-sipper
effect: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.
descriptionEs: Neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Planta y sube su Ataque.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.

name: prankster
effect: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.
descriptionEs: Sus movimientos de estado tienen prioridad alta.
descriptionEn: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.

name: sand-force
effect: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Tierra, Acero y Roca durante las tormentas de arena.
descriptionEn: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

name: iron-barbs
effect: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
descriptionEs: Inflige daño al rival si este le golpea con un movimiento de contacto.
descriptionEn: Inflicts damage on the attacker upon contact with iron barbs.

name: zen-mode
effect: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.
descriptionEs: Cambia de forma si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad.
descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is half or less.

name: victory-star
effect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.1× for friendly Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Sube su Precisión y la de sus aliados.
descriptionEn: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.

name: turboblaze
effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
descriptionEs: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

name: teravolt
effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
descriptionEs: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

name: aroma-veil
effect: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.
descriptionEs: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados de ataques que impiden elegir movimientos.
descriptionEn: Protects the Pokémon and its allies from effects that prevent the use of moves.

name: flower-veil
effect: Protects friendly Grass Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Evita que los Pokémon de tipo Planta aliados sufran problemas de estado o que les bajen sus características.
descriptionEn: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

name: cheek-pouch
effect: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.
descriptionEs: Recupera PS al comer cualquier baya.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.

name: protean
effect: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.
descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

name: fur-coat
effect: Halves damage from physical attacks.
descriptionEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques físicos del rival.
descriptionEn: Halves the damage from physical moves.

name: magician
effect: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.
descriptionEs: Roba el objeto del Pokémon al que alcance con un movimiento.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

name: bulletproof
effect: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.
descriptionEs: No le afectan las bombas ni algunos proyectiles.
descriptionEn: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.

name: competitive
effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
descriptionEs: Aumenta mucho su Ataque Especial cuando el rival le baja cualquiera de sus características.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

name: strong-jaw
effect: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.
descriptionEs: Su robusta mandíbula le confiere una mordedura potente.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

name: refrigerate
effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Ice moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
descriptionEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hielo y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
descriptionEn: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

name: sweet-veil
effect: Prevents friendly Pokémon from sleeping.
descriptionEs: No cae dormido y evita también que sus aliados se duerman.
descriptionEn: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.

name: stance-change
effect: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.
descriptionEs: Adopta la Forma Filo al lanzar un ataque, o bien la Forma Escudo si usa el movimiento Escudo Real.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.

name: gale-wings
effect: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.
descriptionEs: Da prioridad a los movimientos de tipo Volador si sus PS están al máximo.
descriptionEn: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.

name: mega-launcher
effect: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de algunos movimientos de pulsos y auras.
descriptionEn: Powers up pulse moves.

name: grass-pelt
effect: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Defensa si hay un campo de hierba en el terreno de combate.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.

name: symbiosis
effect: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.
descriptionEs: Pasa su objeto a un aliado que ya haya utilizado el suyo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.

name: tough-claws
effect: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de contacto.
descriptionEn: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

name: pixilate
effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Fairy moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
descriptionEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hada y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
descriptionEn: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

name: gooey
effect: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.
descriptionEs: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

name: aerilate
effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Flying moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
descriptionEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Volador y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
descriptionEn: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

name: parental-bond
effect: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves.  The second hit has half power.
descriptionEs: Une fuerzas con su cría y ataca dos veces.
descriptionEn: Parent and child each attacks.

name: dark-aura
effect: Strengthens Dark moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Siniestro.
descriptionEn: Powers up each Pokémon’s Dark-type moves.

name: fairy-aura
effect: Strengthens Fairy moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Hada.
descriptionEn: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.

name: aura-break
effect: Makes Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types.
descriptionEs: Invierte los efectos de las auras, por lo que baja la potencia de ciertos movimientos en vez de subirla.
descriptionEn: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.

name: primordial-sea
effect: Creates heavy rain, which has all the properties of Rain Dance, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Fire moves to fail.
descriptionEs: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Fuego.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.

name: desolate-land
effect: Creates extremely harsh sunlight, which has all the properties of Sunny Day, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Water moves to fail.
descriptionEs: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Agua.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.

name: delta-stream
effect: Creates a mysterious air current, which cannot be replaced and causes moves to never be super effective against Flying Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Altera el clima para anular las vulnerabilidades del tipo Volador.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type’s weaknesses.

name: stamina
effect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Defensa al recibir un ataque.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

name: wimp-out
effect: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.
descriptionEs: Se asusta y abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

name: emergency-exit
effect: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.
descriptionEs: Abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad para evitar males mayores.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

name: water-compaction
effect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.
descriptionEs: Aumenta mucho su Defensa si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.

name: merciless
effect: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.
descriptionEs: Hace que sus movimientos asesten siempre un golpe crítico si el rival está envenenado.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

name: shields-down
effect: Transforms this Minior between Core Form and Meteor Form.  Prevents major status ailments and drowsiness while in Meteor Form.
descriptionEs: Rompe su coraza cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad y adopta una forma ofensiva.
descriptionEn: When its HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.

name: stakeout
effect: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.
descriptionEs: Si el objetivo de su ataque es sustituido por otro, duplica el daño que infligirá.
descriptionEn: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

name: water-bubble
effect: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.
descriptionEs: Reduce el daño que le provocan los movimientos de tipo Fuego y es inmune a las quemaduras.
descriptionEn: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.

name: steelworker
effect: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero.
descriptionEn: Powers up Steel-type moves.

name: berserk
effect: Raises this Pokémon's Special Attack by one stage every time its HP drops below half.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque Especial si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad debido a algún ataque.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.

name: slush-rush
effect: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Velocidad si está granizando.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

name: long-reach
effect: This Pokémon's moves do not make contact.
descriptionEs: Puede usar cualquier movimiento sin entrar en contacto con el rival.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

name: liquid-voice
effect: Sound-based moves become Water-type.
descriptionEs: Hace que todos sus movimientos que usan sonido pasen a ser de tipo Agua.
descriptionEn: Sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

name: triage
effect: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
descriptionEs: Da prioridad a los movimientos que restauran PS.
descriptionEn: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.

name: galvanize
effect: This Pokémon's Normal moves are Electric and have their power increased to 1.2×.
descriptionEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Eléctrico y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
descriptionEn: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

name: surge-surfer
effect: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.
descriptionEs: Duplica su Velocidad si hay un campo eléctrico en el terreno de combate.
descriptionEn: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

name: schooling
effect: Wishiwashi becomes Schooling Form when its HP is 25% or higher.
descriptionEs: Forma bancos con sus congéneres cuando tiene muchos PS, lo cual le otorga más fuerza. Cuando le quedan pocos PS, el banco se dispersa.
descriptionEn: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.

name: disguise
effect: Prevents the first instance of battle damage.
descriptionEs: Puede eludir un ataque valiéndose de la tela que le cubre el cuerpo una vez por combate.
descriptionEn: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

name: battle-bond
effect: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent.  Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.
descriptionEs: Al derrotar a un rival, los vínculos con su Entrenador se refuerzan y se convierte en Greninja Ash. Su Shuriken de Agua también se ve potenciado.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its bond with its Trainer is strengthened, and its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted.

name: power-construct
effect: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%.
descriptionEs: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, las células se reagrupan y adopta su Forma Completa.
descriptionEn: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.

name: corrosion
effect: This Pokémon can inflict poison on Poison and Steel Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Puede envenenar incluso a rivales de tipo Acero o Veneno.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

name: comatose
effect: This Pokémon always  acts as though it were Asleep.
descriptionEs: No despierta jamás de su profundo letargo e incluso ataca dormido.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack while in its sleeping state.

name: queenly-majesty
effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.
descriptionEs: Intimida al objetivo y le impide usar movimientos con prioridad.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

name: innards-out
effect: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.
descriptionEs: Al caer debilitado, inflige al rival un daño equivalente a los PS que le quedaran.
descriptionEn: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.

name: dancer
effect: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.
descriptionEs: Puede copiar inmediatamente cualquier movimiento de baile que haya usado otro Pokémon presente en el combate.
descriptionEn: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.

name: battery
effect: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.
descriptionEs: Potencia los ataques especiales de los aliados.
descriptionEn: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.

name: fluffy
effect: Damage from contact moves is halved.  Damage from Fire moves is doubled.
descriptionEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño provocado por los movimientos de contacto, pero duplica el infligido por los de tipo Fuego.
descriptionEn: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

name: dazzling
effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.
descriptionEs: Desconcierta al rival y le impide utilizar movimientos con prioridad en su contra.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

name: soul-heart
effect: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque Especial cada vez que un Pokémon cae debilitado.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.

name: tangling-hair
effect: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.
descriptionEs: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

name: receiver
effect: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
descriptionEs: Adquiere la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

name: power-of-alchemy
effect: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
descriptionEs: Reacciona copiando la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

name: beast-boost
effect: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Si derrota a un rival en ese turno, aumenta su característica más fuerte.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.

name: rks-system
effect: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory.
descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo según el disco que lleve instalado.
descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.

name: electric-surge
effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.
descriptionEs: Crea un campo eléctrico al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: psychic-surge
effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.
descriptionEs: Crea un campo psíquico al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: misty-surge
effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.
descriptionEs: Crea un campo de niebla al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: grassy-surge
effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.
descriptionEs: Crea un campo de hierba al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: full-metal-body
effect: Other Pokémon cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.
descriptionEs: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.

name: shadow-shield
effect: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage from moves is halved.
descriptionEs: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
descriptionEn: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

name: prism-armor
effect: Reduces super-effective damage to 0.75×.
descriptionEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
descriptionEn: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

name: neuroforce
effect: Increases super-effective damage dealt to 1.25×.
descriptionEs: Potencia los ataques supereficaces.
descriptionEn: Powers up moves that are super effective.

name: intrepid-sword
effect: Boosts Attack in battle.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: dauntless-shield
effect: Boosts Defense in battle.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Defensa al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

name: libero
effect: Libero changes the Pokémon's type to that of its previously used attack.
descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

name: ball-fetch
effect: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
descriptionEs: Si no lleva equipado ningún objeto, recupera la Poké Ball del primer intento de captura fallido.
descriptionEn: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

name: cotton-down
effect: When Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
descriptionEs: Al ser alcanzado por un ataque, suelta una pelusa de algodón que reduce la Velocidad de todos los demás Pokémon.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

name: propeller-tail
effect: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
descriptionEs: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
descriptionEn: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

name: mirror-armor
effect: Reflects any stat-lowering effects.
descriptionEs: Refleja los efectos que reducen las características.
descriptionEn: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

name: gulp-missile
effect: If a Cramorant with Gulp Missile uses Surf or Dive, it catches prey and changes its form depending on its remaining HP.
descriptionEs: Tras usar Surf o Buceo, emerge con una presa en la boca. Al recibir daño, ataca escupiéndola al rival.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

name: stalwart
effect: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
descriptionEs: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
descriptionEn: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

name: steam-engine
effect: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Fuego o Agua, le sube muchísimo la Velocidad.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

name: punk-rock
effect: Boosts sound-based moves and halves damage from the same moves.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos que usan sonido y reduce a la mitad el daño que le infligen dichos movimientos.
descriptionEn: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

name: sand-spit
effect: Creates a sandstorm when hit by an attack.
descriptionEs: Provoca una tormenta de arena al recibir un ataque.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

name: ice-scales
effect: Halves damage from Special moves.
descriptionEs: Las gélidas escamas que protegen su cuerpo reducen a la mitad el daño que le infligen los ataques especiales.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

name: ripen
effect: Doubles the effect of berries.
descriptionEs: Hace madurar las bayas, por lo que duplica sus efectos.
descriptionEn: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

name: ice-face
effect: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.
descriptionEs: Absorbe el daño de un ataque físico con el hielo de la cabeza, tras lo cual cambia de forma. El hielo se regenerará la próxima vez que granice.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

name: power-spot
effect: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de los Pokémon adyacentes.
descriptionEn: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

name: mimicry
effect: Changes type depending on the terrain.
descriptionEs: Cambia su tipo según el campo que haya en el terreno de combate.
descriptionEn: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

name: screen-cleaner
effect: Nullifies effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.
descriptionEs: Anula los efectos de Pantalla de Luz, Reflejo y Velo Aurora tanto de rivales como de aliados al entrar en combate.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

name: steely-spirit
effect: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero de los aliados.
descriptionEn: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.

name: perish-body
effect: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, se debilitará al cabo de 3 turnos, así como su agresor, a menos que abandonen el terreno de combate.
descriptionEn: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

name: wandering-spirit
effect: Swaps abilities with opponents on contact.
descriptionEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, intercambia su habilidad con la del agresor.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

name: gorilla-tactics
effect: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
descriptionEs: Potencia su Ataque, pero solo puede usar el primer movimiento escogido.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

name: neutralizing-gas
effect: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.
descriptionEs: Anula los efectos de las habilidades de los demás Pokémon presentes mientras esté en el terreno de combate.
descriptionEn: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

name: pastel-veil
effect: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being poisoned.
descriptionEs: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados del envenenamiento.
descriptionEn: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.

name: hunger-switch
effect: Causes Morpeko to change its form each turn, alternating between Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode
descriptionEs: Alterna entre su Forma Saciada y Forma Voraz al final de cada turno.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

name: quick-draw
effect: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
descriptionEs: A veces, puede atacar el primero.
descriptionEn: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

name: unseen-fist
effect: Contact moves can strike through Protect/Detect.
descriptionEs: Si usa un movimiento de contacto, puede infligir daño al objetivo aunque este se proteja.
descriptionEn: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

name: curious-medicine
effect: Resets all stat changes upon entering battlefield.
descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate, rezuma una substancia medicinal por la caracola que revierte los cambios en las características de los aliados.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

name: transistor
effect: Powers up Electric-type moves.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico.
descriptionEn: Powers up Electric-type moves.

name: dragons-maw
effect: Powers up Dragon-type moves.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón.
descriptionEn: Powers up Dragon-type moves.

name: chilling-neigh
effect: Boosts Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho gélido y aumenta su Ataque.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

name: grim-neigh
effect: Boosts Special Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
descriptionEs: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho aterrador y aumenta su Ataque Especial.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

name: as-one-glastrier
effect: Combines the effects of Unnerve and Chilling Neigh.
descriptionEs: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Blanco de Glastrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
descriptionEn: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.

name: as-one-spectrier
effect: Combines the effects of Unnerve and Grim Neigh.
descriptionEs: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Negro de Spectrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
descriptionEn: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Spectrier's Grim Neigh Ability.

name: lingering-aroma
effect: Contact changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
descriptionEs: Contagia la habilidad Olor Persistente al Pokémon que lo ataque con un movimiento de contacto.
descriptionEn: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

name: seed-sower
effect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
descriptionEs: Crea un campo de hierba al recibir un ataque.
descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

name: thermal-exchange
effect: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.
descriptionEs: Evita las quemaduras y, si lo alcanza un movimiento de tipo Fuego, aumenta su Ataque.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

name: anger-shell
effect: When the Pokémon's HP drops below half, Anger Shell lowers its Defense and Special Defense but its Attack, Special Attack and Speed are raised.
descriptionEs: Cuando un ataque reduce sus PS a la mitad, un arrebato de cólera reduce su Defensa y su Defensa Especial, pero aumenta su Ataque, su Ataque Especial y su Velocidad.
descriptionEn: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

name: purifying-salt
effect: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.
descriptionEs: Su sal pura lo protege de los problemas de estado y reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques de tipo Fantasma.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

name: well-baked-body
effect: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.
descriptionEs: Si lo alcanza un movimiento de tipo Fuego, aumenta mucho su Defensa en vez de sufrir daño.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

name: wind-rider
effect: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.
descriptionEs: Si sopla un Viento Afín o lo alcanza un movimiento que usa viento, aumenta su Ataque. Tampoco recibe daño de este último.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

name: guard-dog
effect: Boosts Attack if intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.
descriptionEs: Aumenta su Ataque si sufre los efectos de Intimidación. También anula movimientos y objetos que fuercen el cambio de Pokémon.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

name: rocky-payload
effect: Powers up Rock-type moves.
descriptionEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Roca.
descriptionEn: Powers up Rock-type moves.

name: wind-power
effect: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
descriptionEs: Su cuerpo se carga de electricidad si lo alcanza un movimiento que usa viento, lo que potencia su siguiente movimiento de tipo Eléctrico.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

name: zero-to-hero
effect: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.
descriptionEs: Adopta la Forma Heroica cuando se retira del combate.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

name: commander
effect: Goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.
descriptionEs: Si al entrar en combate coincide con un Dondozo aliado, se cuela en el interior de su boca para tomar el control.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

name: electromorphosis
effect: When hit by an attack, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
descriptionEs: Su cuerpo se carga de electricidad al recibir daño, lo que potencia su siguiente movimiento de tipo Eléctrico.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

name: protosynthesis
effect: Raises highest stat in harsh sunlight, or if holding Booster Energy.
descriptionEs: Si hace sol o lleva un tanque de Energía Potenciadora, aumenta su característica más alta.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

name: quark-drive
effect: Raises highest stat on Electric Terrain, or if holding Booster Energy.
descriptionEs: Si hay un campo eléctrico en el terreno de combate o lleva un tanque de Energía Potenciadora, aumenta su característica más alta.
descriptionEn: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

name: good-as-gold
effect: Gives immunity to status moves.
descriptionEs: Su robusto cuerpo de oro inoxidable lo hace inmune frente a movimientos de estado de otros Pokémon.
descriptionEn: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

name: vessel-of-ruin
effect: Lowers Special Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
descriptionEs: Reduce el Ataque Especial de todos los demás Pokémon con el poder de su caldero maldito.
descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

name: sword-of-ruin
effect: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
descriptionEs: Reduce la Defensa de todos los demás Pokémon con el poder de su espada maldita.
descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

name: tablets-of-ruin
effect: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
descriptionEs: Reduce el Ataque de todos los demás Pokémon con el poder de sus tablillas malditas.
descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

name: beads-of-ruin
effect: Lowers Special Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
descriptionEs: Reduce la Defensa Especial de todos los demás Pokémon con el poder de sus abalorios malditos.
descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

name: orichalcum-pulse
effect: Turns the sunlight harsh when entering battle, and boosts Attack while active.
descriptionEs: El tiempo pasa a ser soleado cuando entra en combate. Si hace mucho sol, su Ataque aumenta gracias a su pulso primigenio.
descriptionEn: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

name: hadron-engine
effect: Creates an Electric Terrain when entering battle, and boosts Special Attack while active.
descriptionEs: Crea un campo eléctrico al entrar en combate. Si hay un campo eléctrico, su Ataque Especial aumenta gracias a su motor futurista.
descriptionEn: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

name: opportunist
effect: Copies stat boosts by the opponent.
descriptionEs: Copia las mejoras en las características del rival, aprovechándose de la situación.
descriptionEn: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

name: cud-chew
effect: Causes the Pokémon to reuse an already consumed Berry at the end of the next turn.
descriptionEs: Cuando ingiere una baya, la regurgita al final del siguiente turno y se la come por segunda vez.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

name: sharpness
effect: Powers up slicing moves.
descriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos cortantes.
descriptionEn: Powers up slicing moves.

name: supreme-overlord
effect: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.
descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate, su Ataque y su Ataque Especial aumentan un poco por cada miembro del equipo que haya sido derrotado hasta el momento.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

name: costar
effect: Copies ally's stat changes on entering battle.
descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate, copia los cambios en las características de su aliado.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

name: toxic-debris
effect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
descriptionEs: Al recibir daño de un ataque físico, lanza una trampa de púas tóxicas a los pies del rival.
descriptionEn: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

name: armor-tail
effect: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.
descriptionEs: La extraña cola que le envuelve la cabeza impide al rival utilizar movimientos con prioridad.
