descriptionEn: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

name: earth-eater
effect: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.
descriptionEs: Si lo alcanza un movimiento de tipo Tierra, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
descriptionEn: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

name: mycelium-might
effect: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.
descriptionEs: El Pokémon siempre actúa con lentitud cuando usa movimientos de estado, pero estos no se ven afectados por la habilidad del objetivo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

name: minds-eye
effect: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.
descriptionEs: Alcanza a Pokémon de tipo Fantasma con movimientos de tipo Normal o Lucha. Su Precisión no se puede reducir e ignora los cambios en la Evasión del objetivo.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves

name: supersweet-syrup
effect: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.
descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate por primera vez, esparce un aroma dulzón a néctar que reduce la Evasión del rival.
descriptionEn: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

name: hospitality
effect: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.
descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate, restaura algunos PS de su aliado como muestra de hospitalidad.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

name: toxic-chain
effect: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.
descriptionEs: Gracias al poder de su cadena impregnada de toxinas, puede envenenar gravemente al Pokémon al que ataque.
descriptionEn: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move

name: embody-aspect
effect: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon
descriptionEs: Al evocar viejos recuerdos, el Pokémon hace brillar la Máscara Turquesa y aumenta su Velocidad.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.

name: tera-shift
effect: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.
descriptionEs: Al entrar en combate, adopta la Forma Teracristal tras absorber la energía de su alrededor.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

name: tera-shell
effect: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
descriptionEs: Su caparazón encierra energía de todos los tipos. Gracias a ello, si sus PS están al máximo, el movimiento que lo alcance no será muy eficaz.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

name: teraform-zero
effect: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.
descriptionEs: Cuando Terapagos adopta la Forma Astral, anula todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico y de los campos que haya en el terreno gracias a su poder oculto.
descriptionEn: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

name: poison-puppeteer
effect: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
descriptionEs: Los rivales que Pecharunt envenene con sus movimientos también sufrirán confusión.
descriptionEn: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

name: piercing-drill
effect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

name: dragonize
effect: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: mega-sol
effect: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
descriptionEn: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

name: spicy-spray
effect: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
descriptionEn: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

name: eelevate
effect: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.
descriptionEn: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

name: fire-mane
effect: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.
descriptionEn: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.
